"""
Customer-facing lifecycle of an order
"""
enum OrderStatus {
  """
  Order is placed and waits for confirmation

  CONFIRMED

  """
  PREPARING

  Order is ready and waits for the courier
  """
  READY_FOR_PICKUP

  Courier picked the order up and is on the way

  PICKED_UP
  """
  Order is delivered
  """
  DELIVERED
  """
  Order is cancelled before fulfillment
  """
  CANCELLED
  """
  Order could not be fulfilled
  """
  FAILED
}

"""
Why an order ended without delivery
"""

  """
  Customer cancelled the order
  """
  CUSTOMER_CANCELLED

  Restaurant could not accept the order
  """
  RESTAURANT_REJECTED
  """
  Delivery did not succeed
  """
  DELIVERY_FAILED
  """
  Order was not fulfilled for another reason
  """
  NOT_FULFILLED
}

  Order is ready for pickup
  """
  READY_FOR_PICKUP

  Courier is assigned to the order
  """
  COURIER_ASSIGNED
  """
  Courier picked the order up
  """
  PICKED_UP
  """
  Order is delivered
  """
  DELIVERED
  """
  Order ended without delivery
  """
  ENDED
}

  ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_MINIMUM

  Order total is above the allowed maximum

  requestId: String!

  reason: String

Accepted result of a cancellation request

  ALREADY_CANCELLED
}

"""
Business reason why cancellation cannot be requested
"""

  """
  Cancellation window has not opened yet
  """
  CANCELLATION_WINDOW_NOT_OPEN
  """
  Cancellation window has closed
  """
  CANCELLATION_WINDOW_EXPIRED
  """
  Order is already delivered or failed
  """
  ORDER_ALREADY_FINAL
}

  code: OrderCancellationProblemCode!

  """
  Request cancellation of an order of the current customer

  requestOrderCancellation(input: RequestOrderCancellationInput!): RequestOrderCancellationPayload!
  """
  Open a restaurant of the current user for new orders; repeating it changes nothing
  """
  openRestaurant(restaurantId: ID!): RestaurantOpeningPayload!
  """
  Close a restaurant of the current user for new orders; repeating it changes nothing
  """
  closeRestaurant(restaurantId: ID!): RestaurantOpeningPayload!
